published.source: tradeshallglasgow.co.uk/rooms (research/research-room-facts.md, fetched 2026-10-17); the venue's plan labels 11.9 x 6.9 m
published.note: Measured: 12.19 m (panelling, front to rear) x 7.47 m (fireplace panelling to the window piers; 7.01 m between the end sections at the front, 7.10 m at the rear), 89.3 m2 inside the panelling; ceiling field 5.515 m, raised panels to 5.855 m, wall plaster to the cornice at 5.45 m. Drawing and planning use the measured outline; published capacities are kept (website 80 theatre / 40 classroom / 60 dinner / 80 reception).

transform.note: x = 7.565 - Y, y = Z - 0.002, z = -2.065 - X. A proper rotation (det +1); the window wall is on -z (z = -3.734) and +x points 101.1 deg true. The centre is the panelling's centre within 4 mm (X -2.068, Y 7.566) and the ceiling's (-2.07, 7.55); floor Z 0.002 is the floor plane at the centre (fit 0.0054 + 0.00135 X, rms 7 mm).

site.note: Derived from the Grand Hall frame constants (README, merchant-city-v2 frame block): the Saloon's planner -z is E57 +X, 90 deg left of the Grand Hall's -z (101.1 true, 102.96 grid). gridOrigin = the Grand Hall's (259332, 665191) + the Saloon origin's Grand Hall planner position (x 10.860, z 12.528) on +x (-0.22427, -0.97453) and +z (-0.97453, 0.22427). The windows look into a roofed space over the booking suite (LiDAR roof at Z 11.5-12 from 0.5 m out; FIRST 2010 F.03); the glass is lit from behind and no sun reaches the floor.

stations.note: The lobby between the Grand Hall's end door and the Saloon, 0.29 m beyond the front wall's face; the Grand Hall lists it too.

ceiling.note: Flat field at 5.515 with a ring of 36 octagonal coffers with rosettes (recessed to 5.63; 7 per short side, 13 per long side, pitch 0.90-0.92 m, ring centrelines E57 X -4.83 / 0.69, Y 2.20 / 12.89), a framed inner panel at 5.567, three raised squares at 5.713 and central raised panels at 5.855; a shallow cornice from 5.45. From down-facing mesh surfaces on a 5 cm raster; the ceiling relief should come from the mesh, these regions summarise it.

floor.note: Oak herringbone: spines run along the room (E57 Y, planner x); the joint direction flips every 0.355 m across the room (6 courses over E57 X -3.28..-1.15, native skybox faces of scan_058). Block width not settled (42-70 mm between an FFT and the eye): measure it on the floor photograph. Floor flat to 7 mm rms, 1.4 mm/m fall along E57 X.

fittings.note: Gilt scrolled electrolier, about three tiers of candle lamps. Axis E57 (-2.096, 4.882); mesh lowest point Z 3.625 (finial at 3.60 on its axis plane in the native skybox faces); widest at 4.2-4.4 m; body top about 4.9 m; rose on the raised panel at 5.857. Reach = 98th percentile radius of the mesh body. Needs a new fitting template.

provenance.method: Plan sections of the reviewed Matterport dollhouse mesh (dump checked against the GLB's accessor bounds to 0.001 mm) with robust line fits (RANSAC then Tukey IRLS) in four height bands; orthographic depth rasters of each wall (2 cm) for openings, bays and relief bands; down-facing surfaces on a 5 cm raster for the ceiling; clustering for fittings and furniture; opening edges against a metric grid in orthographic crops from the native E57 skybox faces (4096^2, oriented by correlation with the twin's world-aligned 512 px panoramas, r 0.92-0.99). Scripts: tools/surveyed-rooms/measure/saloon/.
